stories.head: True Anomaly raises $190M for co-orbital security
stories.body: True Anomaly has secured a $190 million Series C round, pushing its valuation to $1.6 billion. The funding will bolster its co-orbital security and space domain awareness capabilities, a timely move as the U.S. Department of Defense increases its focus on space threats. With DoD pull-through now a headline, True Anomaly is positioning itself as a key player in an increasingly competitive market.
stories.soWhat: If the government is betting big on co-orbital security, it might signal that traditional defense contractors are feeling the heat from agile newcomers.

stories.head: Anduril and L3Harris team up for tactical SDA
stories.body: Anduril and L3Harris have joined forces to bid for a tactical Space Development Agency constellation project. This partnership reflects a growing trend of collaboration between established defense firms and tech startups, aiming to leverage their respective strengths in a bid for government contracts. The SDA's focus on rapid deployment could favor nimble players like Anduril, which is known for its innovative defense solutions.
stories.soWhat: Expect more of these partnerships as larger firms seek to tap into the agility of startups while the latter aim for legitimacy through association.

stories.head: FY27 budget adds $1.4B for space resilience
stories.body: The FY27 budget markup has allocated an additional $1.4 billion for space resilience efforts, reflecting a growing recognition of the strategic importance of space assets. This funding is likely to support a range of initiatives, from satellite upgrades to cybersecurity measures. As threats in space increase, this financial commitment indicates that the government is finally taking the issue seriously.
stories.soWhat: More money in space resilience means less room for complacency; companies need to step up their game or risk being left behind.

watchlist.body: With significant funding secured, True Anomaly's strategic decisions will be crucial as it seeks to capitalize on its new resources.

watchlist.title: Watch for deltaVision's production ramp-up
watchlist.body: With a €10.2 million funding round, deltaVision's expansion in valve production for in-space refueling is worth monitoring for potential partnerships.

talent.statLabel: Job orders YoY · plus 2 starters per head, an 8-year first
talent.head: Demand has doubled. So has our hit rate.
talent.body: EVONA's job orders are up 2.0× year-over-year, and for the first time in our eight-year history we're placing two new starters per EVONA staff member. The first number says demand is real. The second says we're converting it, which in recruitment is the only number that actually matters. Growth is heaviest in Series B/C startups; primes are running flat. Compensation isn't the variable. The constraint is schedule risk in the primes: senior engineers leave Boeing, Lockheed, Northrop because they want to ship hardware before retirement.
